composites.name: pulse_cardiovascular
composites.description: The Pulse cardiovascular circuit (with its renal and tissue branches) in the real whole-body engine: per-compartment pressures, volumes and flows plus hemodynamic vitals, driven by circuit resistance/compliance multipliers and a hemorrhage.

state_file.description: Stabilized Pulse patient state in <install>/bin/states (whole_body only; set this or patient_file, not both)

patient_file.description: Patient in <install>/bin/patients (on whole_body, also a path). ventilation_mechanics starts from it; on whole_body it replaces state_file, stabilized once (about 13 s) and then cached

circuit_modifiers.description: Circuit path or node name -> multiplier on the resistance, compliance or volume Pulse initializes it with (whole_body only). The patient is stabilized with them (about 25 s the first time, then cached), so the rest of the body adapts: a different patient, not a perturbation

interval.description: Seconds per update; 0.02 (Pulse's timestep) resolves per-beat/per-breath waveforms. A non-binary-exact interval can lose the final update of a run to float time accumulation.

point_reads.description: Also read every node and path of the circuit drawing (whole_body only), under circuits/<circuit>_points/

composites.name: pulse_mechanical_ventilation
composites.description: A patient on a pressure-control mechanical ventilator in the real Pulse engine: the respiratory circuit combined with the ventilator circuit, emitting breathing mechanics, lung compartments and the ventilator's monitor values. Defaults follow Pulse's HowTo_VentilationMechanics (intubated; PC-AC 19/5 cmH2O, 12 bpm).

composites.name: pulse_thermal
composites.description: The Pulse temperature circuit (internal core/skin joined to clothing, enclosure and ambient air) in the real whole-body engine: core and skin temperature, sweat, metabolic rate, heat-loss rates and per-compartment temperatures and heat flows, driven by the environmental conditions and by active heating, cooling or an applied skin temperature.

mean_radiant_temperature_C.description: Mean radiant temperature of the surroundings

respiration_ambient_temperature_C.description: Temperature of the air breathed; drives respiration heat loss

clothing_resistance_clo.description: Clothing thermal resistance (1 clo = 0.155 m^2 K/W)

composites.name: pulse_whole_body_circuits
composites.description: Every circuit module on one real whole-body Pulse engine: cardiovascular (with renal and tissue branches), respiratory, mechanical ventilator, thermal and supplemental oxygen, so effects that cross circuits appear in one run. All setpoints start at their baselines; the ventilator and oxygen start disconnected, and only one of them can be connected at a time.
